report.title: Invalid amount not detected
report.summary: The page did not detect an invalid amount when a non-numeric value was entered. This could allow users to make invalid payments.
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Go to the Bill Pay page
2. Enter a non-numeric value in the Amount field
report.expected: The page should display an error message when an invalid amount is entered
report.actual: The page did not display an error message, and the element 'Invalid amount' was not found
report.suspected_cause: The page's validation logic may be faulty or incomplete.
report.next_action: The development team should review the page's validation logic and ensure that it correctly detects invalid amounts.
